scope: correctness, real-witness differential, lifecycle, memory and single full-job observations; not a controlled performance comparison

source_continuity.reason: Align engine workspace Cargo.lock with the new optional metal dependency after proof validation; root-worker compiled inputs and binaries unchanged.

contents.scope: device only; shader compilation is on the proof path

engine_patch.scope: includes tracked changes and all new engine implementation files; reverse-apply check passed

limitations: Complete latency observations are not a controlled five-pair comparison or new warm-median baseline.
Arithmetic, hashing and boundaries do not establish marketplace or BigInt/ECDSA workload performance.
Sampled process-group peaks are guarded, not a kernel-enforced hard cap; GPU compiler services are outside the group.
CPU scatter, prefix products and zeroization remain alongside CPU witness, accumulation and identity-p254.
A separate preliminary candidate was stopped for an FFI raw-pointer review; its three verified proofs are excluded from these totals.
